$comment: DevOS profile schema v0.1.0 (provisional). Human + machine reference. The authoritative validator is packages/cli/devos/schema.py; this file documents the contract. JSON is used for the engine's own profile/lock format in this first slice (dependency-free); a YAML loader is a tracked later option — see DECISIONS.md O-11.
title: DevOS Profile
description: Declarative description of a set of DevOps capabilities a workstation should have. A profile states desired capabilities and their approved sources; a lockfile (locks/<name>.lock.json) records the resolved, verified inputs.

fields.name: kebab-case profile id, e.g. 'core'.
fields.tool.name: Required. Package/tool identifier.
fields.tool.capability: Optional. What the tool provides, e.g. 'vcs'.
fields.tool.source: Required. One of: apt | snap | binary.
fields.tool.verification: Required when source == 'binary'. Must carry {method, checksum}. method in {upstream-signature, attestation}. A checksum copied from the same unauthenticated download page (TOFU) is NOT accepted; if no upstream signature exists, set method='fallback' AND fallbackApproved=true AND residualRisk='<text>' (master prompt §9.1).
